# Contributing to Sloppery repositories

Read [`sloppery-dev/docs/repository-contract.md`](https://github.com/the-sloppery/sloppery-dev/blob/main/docs/repository-contract.md) before editing.

Keep changes inside the owning repository. Put organization settings in
[`iac-sloppery`](https://github.com/the-sloppery/iac-sloppery) and durable agent
context in [`sloppery-dev`](https://github.com/the-sloppery/sloppery-dev).

Every pull request states its exact source head, checks actually run, evidence,
remaining unknowns, and any ownership handoff. Do not commit credentials or
production data.
